thesis: Community Financial System (NYSE: CBU), Upstate New York and Pennsylvania community bank with employee benefit services (36.4M of Q3 fee revenue), insurance and wealth management. Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-11-06) read. 9M NI 179.9M vs 156.0M (+15%); Q3 NI 61.3M vs 55.1M; Q3 net interest income 143.5M vs 128.2M (+12%); NIM 3.54% (3.30% a year earlier) for 9M; efficiency ratio 62.0% (operating 59.8%); ROE 11.8%, ROA 1.37% (9M, annualized by the company); noninterest revenue 246.3M (+7%). Credit: allowance 92.0M = 0.80% of loans of 11.52B; ACL/nonperforming loans 152%; nonaccrual 0.43% of loans; Q3 net charge-offs 0.18% annualized (5.1M, including 2.7M on two business relationships); 65% of nonperforming loans are consumer mortgages. Capital: CET1 13.73%, leverage 9.37% (company), well capitalized; but AOCI loss of 484.2M on 2.56B AFS securities (unrealized loss 619.6M pretax on securities) equals about 24% of equity and is excluded from regulatory CET1, so tangible book 21.17 per share (1,108.7M / 52.377M shares) includes it. TTM NI (USD M) = FY2025 210.455 + 9M26 179.856 - 9M25 156.033 = 234.3. Close 62.45 (2026-11-19) x 52,377K period end shares = 3.27B = 14.0x TTM NI; 1.61x book (38.77) and 2.95x tangible book (21.17); dividend 0.49 per quarter = 3.1% yield, Q3 payout about 41%. Deposits 14.87B (noninterest bearing 3.89B, 26%), borrowings 0.64B, loans to deposits 77%. Possible market view: slow growth Northeast bank with large unrealized securities losses. Differing evidence: ROE near 12% with improving NIM, 15% earnings growth, strong capital, 37% fee income, tangible book stable (20.57 a year ago to 21.17). Price implies about 14x TTM and 12.6x annualized 9M (own arithmetic, not a forecast). Stock fell from 64.26 on 11-16 to 62.45 (-2.8%).
counterthesis: Net charge-offs doubled year over year to 0.18% and business lending charge-offs rose to 0.23%; commercial real estate exposure was not examined here. AOCI losses of 484M show rate sensitivity: a fall in long yields helps tangible book, a rise hurts it; 4.05B of securities is 23% of assets. Fee income depends on employee benefit services which is competitive. Goodwill and intangibles 967M are 48% of equity, leaving tangible common equity at 6.2% of assets (1,108.7M / 17.79B, own arithmetic) and the Bank level CET1 (11.73%) is below the holding company's. Acquisitions (intangibles rose 25M in 9M) carry integration risk; amortization of intangibles 13.0M in 9M. NIM expansion of 24 bp may not persist if deposit costs rise; Q3 included a 2.9M securities loss. Peers (WSFS, Tompkins, NBTB, FNB) and own history not compared; 10-K audit matters not read.
invalidation: Invalidated if nonperforming loans or charge-offs rise sharply (especially commercial real estate or business lending), if NIM reverses below about 3.2%, if long rates rise enough to widen the AOCI loss and force capital raising or buyback cuts, or if a large acquisition dilutes tangible book without return.
